## What changed
<!-- One or two sentences. Link the issue: "Closes #123". -->

## Type of change
- [ ] Fix (typo, bug, layout, accessibility)
- [ ] Edit an existing lesson or live app
- [ ] New lesson or live app
- [ ] Design / objects / styles
- [ ] Docs or tooling

## Screenshots
<!-- Required for anything visual. Light AND dark theme please. -->

## Checklist
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] `npm run check:apps` passes (if a live app or its data changed)
- [ ] Every number shown is measured by a script in `scripts/data/` and the step names its source
- [ ] Objects look like the real thing (see `/objects`)
- [ ] Checked light and dark theme, and a narrow window
- [ ] Updated `docs/spec.md` if behaviour, structure or design changed
